title: SIP NormalizedIntent
description: Canonical internal normalized intent model produced by the SIP pipeline from an IntentEnvelope. NormalizedIntent is never exposed on the wire; IntentEnvelope remains the external protocol object. This schema is informational and documents the internal v0.2 shape.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent. Copied from IntentEnvelope.intent_id.

correlation_id.description: Correlation / trace identifier. Copied from IntentEnvelope.trace_id.

actor.description: Normalized representation of the originating actor.

trust_level.description: Trust level granted to this actor.

scopes.description: Permission scopes granted to the actor.

originator.description: Originator actor ID when this intent was delegated, if provenance was declared.

delegation_chain.description: Ordered list of actor IDs through which authority was delegated.

tenant.description: Optional tenant or organization identifier extracted from context.

goal.description: Human-readable statement of what the actor wants to achieve. Copied from IntentEnvelope.desired_outcome.summary.

constraints.description: Flattened execution constraints extracted from the envelope.

time_budget_ms.description: Maximum allowed execution time in milliseconds.

required_capabilities.description: Required capability names extracted from IntentEnvelope.capability_requirements.

risk_level.description: Declared risk level, if specified. Risk level is a property of capability, not of the envelope.

compliance_requirements.description: Compliance requirement strings extracted from context.additional['compliance'].

data_sensitivity.description: Maximum data sensitivity permitted; mirrors constraints.data_sensitivity.

preferred_execution_mode.description: Preferred execution mode (binding type), extracted from the first protocol binding.

trust_requirements.description: Minimum trust level required, derived from capability requirements or the trust block.

raw_request.description: The original IntentEnvelope serialised as a dict for audit purposes.

metadata.description: Arbitrary additional metadata, including envelope context fields.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this NormalizedIntent was created.
